preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of string t must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of ways to extract k non-overlapping substrings containing t, modulo 10^9 + 7.
